---
title: "Quality Control"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  report_title: "Quality Control"
  colour_greater: 5
  gray_greater: 65
  apply_theme: true
  project_id: ""
  enforce_filter: true
  site_quality_min: "Good"
  veg_quality_min: "Good"
  soil_quality_min: "Good"
  site_allow_null: true
  veg_allow_null: true
  soil_allow_null: true
  bec_use_min: ""
  bec_allow_null: true
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
gray_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))

style_qc_table <- function(df, columns = NULL) {
  if (!apply_theme || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  style_numeric <- function(vec) {
    labels <- as.character(vec)
    vapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
      label <- labels[[i]]
      if (!nzchar(label)) return("")
      num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))
      if (is.na(num)) return(label)
      bg <- ""
      if (!is.na(gray_greater) && num >= gray_greater) {
        bg <- "#e6e6e6"
      } else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && num >= colour_greater) {
        bg <- "#f9e27d"
      }
      if (nzchar(bg)) kableExtra::cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
    }, character(1))
  }
  target_cols <- columns
  if (is.null(target_cols) || length(target_cols) == 0) {
    target_cols <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  }
  target_cols <- intersect(target_cols, names(df))
  for (col_name in target_cols) {
    df[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(df[[col_name]])
  }
  df
}
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("Sample_SU", "Sample_Admin", "Sample_Env", "Sample_Veg")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_USysTableOfLists.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE lists.USysTableOfLists AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
  dbExecute(con, "ATTACH '../data/vpro_lists.duckdb' AS lists")
}
on.exit(dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)
```

```{r queries, include=FALSE}
project_filter <- trimws(params$project_id)
enforce_filter <- isTRUE(params$enforce_filter)

dq_list <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT Item, ItemOrder
   FROM lists.USysTableOfLists
   WHERE lower(ListName) = 'dataquality'"
)
dq_map <- setNames(dq_list$ItemOrder, dq_list$Item)

lookup_quality_order <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(value)))) return(NA_integer_)
  dq_map[[as.character(value)]]
}

site_threshold <- lookup_quality_order(params$site_quality_min)
veg_threshold <- lookup_quality_order(params$veg_quality_min)
soil_threshold <- lookup_quality_order(params$soil_quality_min)

safe_query <- function(table, sql) {
  if (!DBI::dbExistsTable(con, table)) return(data.frame())
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql)
}

su_df <- safe_query("Sample_SU", "SELECT PlotNumber, SiteUnit FROM Sample_SU")
admin_df <- safe_query("Sample_Admin", "SELECT Plot AS PlotNumber, SitePlotQuality, VegPlotQuality, SoilPlotQuality, BEC_Use FROM Sample_Admin")
env_df <- safe_query("Sample_Env", "SELECT PlotNumber, ProjectID, Zone, SubZone, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation FROM Sample_Env")

qc_df <- merge(su_df, admin_df, by = "PlotNumber", all.x = TRUE)
qc_df <- merge(qc_df, env_df, by = "PlotNumber", all.x = TRUE)

if (nzchar(project_filter)) {
  qc_df <- qc_df[qc_df$ProjectID == project_filter, , drop = FALSE]
}

site_order <- vapply(qc_df$SitePlotQuality, lookup_quality_order, integer(1))
veg_order <- vapply(qc_df$VegPlotQuality, lookup_quality_order, integer(1))
soil_order <- vapply(qc_df$SoilPlotQuality, lookup_quality_order, integer(1))

site_ok <- if (!enforce_filter) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else if (is.na(site_threshold)) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else {
  ifelse(is.na(site_order), isTRUE(params$site_allow_null), site_order >= site_threshold)
}

veg_ok <- if (!enforce_filter) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else if (is.na(veg_threshold)) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else {
  ifelse(is.na(veg_order), isTRUE(params$veg_allow_null), veg_order >= veg_threshold)
}

soil_ok <- if (!enforce_filter) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else if (is.na(soil_threshold)) {
  rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
} else {
  ifelse(is.na(soil_order), isTRUE(params$soil_allow_null), soil_order >= soil_threshold)
}

bec_ok <- rep(TRUE, nrow(qc_df))
if (enforce_filter && nzchar(trimws(params$bec_use_min))) {
  bec_val <- qc_df$BEC_Use
  bec_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bec_val))
  min_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$bec_use_min))
  if (!is.na(min_num)) {
    bec_ok <- ifelse(is.na(bec_num), isTRUE(params$bec_allow_null), bec_num >= min_num)
  } else {
    bec_ok <- ifelse(is.na(bec_val) | !nzchar(trimws(bec_val)), isTRUE(params$bec_allow_null), bec_val >= params$bec_use_min)
  }
}

qc_df$include <- site_ok & veg_ok & soil_ok & bec_ok
qc_included <- qc_df[qc_df$include, , drop = FALSE]
qc_removed <- qc_df[!qc_df$include, , drop = FALSE]

qc_removed$RemovedBy <- ""
if (nrow(qc_removed) > 0) {
  fail_site <- !site_ok[!qc_df$include]
  fail_veg <- !veg_ok[!qc_df$include]
  fail_soil <- !soil_ok[!qc_df$include]
  fail_bec <- !bec_ok[!qc_df$include]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(qc_removed))) {
    fails <- c(Site = fail_site[i], Veg = fail_veg[i], Soil = fail_soil[i], BEC = fail_bec[i])
    reasons <- names(fails)[fails]
    qc_removed$RemovedBy[i] <- if (length(reasons) > 1) "Mixed" else if (length(reasons) == 1) reasons else ""
  }
}

missing_required <- env_df[
  is.na(env_df$PlotNumber) | is.na(env_df$ProjectID) | is.na(env_df$Zone) | is.na(env_df$SubZone),
  c("PlotNumber", "ProjectID", "Zone", "SubZone")
]

range_issues <- env_df[
  (env_df$Latitude < 48 | env_df$Latitude > 60) |
    (env_df$Longitude < -140 | env_df$Longitude > -114) |
    (env_df$Elevation < 0 | env_df$Elevation > 4000),
  c("PlotNumber", "Latitude", "Longitude", "Elevation")
]

species_issues <- data.frame()
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Veg")) {
  species_issues <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT v.plotnumber, v.species
     FROM Sample_Veg v
     LEFT JOIN lists.SppList s ON v.species = s.code
     WHERE s.code IS NULL"
  )
  if (nzchar(project_filter) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
    species_issues <- merge(species_issues, env_df[, c("PlotNumber", "ProjectID")], by.x = "plotnumber", by.y = "PlotNumber", all.x = TRUE)
    species_issues <- species_issues[species_issues$ProjectID == project_filter, c("plotnumber", "species"), drop = FALSE]
  }
}
```

# `r params$report_title`

# Quality Control Summary

## Filter Results

```{r qc-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Included = nrow(qc_included),
  Removed = nrow(qc_removed),
  Total = nrow(qc_df)
)
summary_df <- style_qc_table(summary_df)
kbl(summary_df, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Removed Plots (By Reason)

```{r qc-removed, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(qc_removed) > 0) {
  removed_cols <- c("PlotNumber", "SiteUnit", "SitePlotQuality", "VegPlotQuality", "SoilPlotQuality", "BEC_Use", "RemovedBy")
  removed_cols <- removed_cols[removed_cols %in% names(qc_removed)]
  removed_view <- qc_removed[, removed_cols, drop = FALSE]
  removed_view <- style_qc_table(removed_view)
  kbl(removed_view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No plots removed by the quality filter.")
}
```

## Missing Required Fields

```{r missing-required, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(missing_required) > 0) {
  missing_view <- style_qc_table(missing_required)
  kbl(missing_view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No missing required fields detected.")
}
```

## Coordinate Range Issues

```{r range-issues, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(range_issues) > 0) {
  range_view <- style_qc_table(range_issues, columns = c("Latitude", "Longitude", "Elevation"))
  kbl(range_view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No coordinate range issues detected.")
}
```

## Species Code Issues

```{r species-issues, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(species_issues) > 0) {
  species_view <- style_qc_table(species_issues)
  kbl(species_view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No species code issues detected.")
}
```
